args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but src/money.py was
using ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding mode so half-cent amounts
round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the tests (`tests/test_money.py`) and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `test_half_even`.
